title: Fluorescently Labeled Polyamine Uptake via Confocal Microscopy
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Proceed with imaging or additional staining.

steps.title: Seed cells in 96-well plate
steps.instruction: Plate cells into a 96‑well plate and incubate for approximately 24 hours to allow attachment and growth.

steps.title: Add fluorescent polyamines
steps.instruction: On the day of the experiment, aspirate the cell culture medium and add fluorescently labeled polyamines to each well, bringing the total volume to 1000 µL per well.

steps.title: Incubate with polyamines
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂, protected from light, for the desired duration.

steps.title: Wash cells post‑incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS‑T, performing each wash for 5 minutes at room temperature on a rocker.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells with DAPI diluted 1:5000 in PBS‑T for 15 minutes at room temperature, protected from light and on a rocker.

steps.title: Wash cells after DAPI
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS‑T, each wash lasting 5 minutes on a rocker, protected from light.

steps.title: Overnight PBS‑T wash
steps.instruction: Wash the cells overnight with PBS‑T at 4 °C on a rocker, protected from light.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Fix the cells by adding 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS and incubate for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
